collection.title: Fiat Qubo 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Fiat Qubo 2008 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Qubo, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Fiat Qubo 2008 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
